push.title: L 1-4 vs Real Zurich FC | You: 8.7 (4th best match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.7. You played with your head up and your heart out. Love to see it.

DID WELL
+ 8 tackles attempted (up from your usual 4). You chased like a golden retriever after a tennis ball, and I mean that as a compliment.
+ 1.4 up on your usual. Step by step, you're getting there.
+ That's your 4th best match performance with an 8.7. Proud doesn't cover it.

WORK ON
- 44% passing (8 of 18, down from your usual 61%). Think about this: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.
- passing accuracy got you and BellyTb1. Communicate and give each other short options.
- Passes attempted: 18. Top-quarter midfielders live at 25+. Let's move in.
- Tackle success: 38%. Next target: 50%+.
- Key passes: 0. Top midfielders reach 2+. You've got the legs for it.

Homework: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.

tuxedo_slide, one more thing before you log off: The scoreboard counts goals; I count growth.

Rest up, legend. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.title: Finishing
tips: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.

Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.

If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.title: L 1-4 vs Real Zurich FC | You: 7.2 (9th worst match performance)
push.body:
A 7.2, PhogsToffees. It's okay to be frustrated. It's not okay to stay frustrated.

DID WELL
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. You made that keeper earn his paycheck.
+ 4 goals conceded nudged it up +0.1. Every inch.

WORK ON
- 0 goals from 2 on target. Here's the deal: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket. You know you can.
- 70% passing (16 of 23). Training homework: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
- 0.6 under your usual. That's a dip, not a trend. Promise.
- Shots: 2. Mid-pack today, 3+ tomorrow.
- Key passes: 0. The next level is 2+.

Skills corner: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide.

Between you and me, PhogsToffees: A bad touch is just a good touch that got lost.

We'll fix it together. - Coach Lasso

strengths.detail: Key passes: 3 (top quarter of midfielders: 2+); 1 assist, 3 key passes
strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Passes attempted: 15 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 15 or less)
weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
weaknesses.coach: We didn't see enough of you on the ball. I want you in the thick of it.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 0 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.
